# Product Intelligence Document: CarBot Cloud CXM

**Generated by**: /product-intel

**Version**: 1.0

---

## Executive Summary

CarBot Cloud CXM is a free, AI-native Customer Experience Manager designed to serve as the central hub for all CarBot dealer services. It sits on top of existing CRM and DMS systems — not replacing them but unifying communications, AI voice agents, workflow automation, and real-time analytics in a single interface. The platform's defining innovation is a generational UI system with ~20 theme variants that adapt the same data and functionality to the interface each user is most comfortable with: Outlook for veteran managers, Discord or TikTok-style feeds for younger BDC agents. CXM is free for any dealer using any CarBot product, with an open-source release planned for Q2 2025. First autonomous dealer deployment began in February 2025, building on 6 months of internal usage and 3 years of development. [EVIDENCE: transcript MAP-Buying-Center 18:34-19:26] [EVIDENCE: transcript BDC-Pros-Extended 22:35-24:28]

## 1) Glossary

| Term | Definition | Say This | Don't Say This |
|------|-----------|----------|----------------|
| **CXM** | Customer Experience Manager — CarBot's free platform that unifies dealer tools | "Your experience hub" / "Your command center" | "CRM replacement" / "Another CRM" |
| **CarBot Cloud** | The infrastructure and platform layer that CXM runs on | "CarBot Cloud" / "The platform" | "The cloud" (too generic) |
| **AI Watcher** | Background AI process that monitors calls and auto-completes tasks | "AI that handles the follow-through" | "Bot" / "Robot" |
| **AI Persona** | A configurable AI voice agent with specific personality and instructions | "Your AI teammate" / "Named agent" | "Voice bot" / "IVR" |
| **Visual Workflow Editor** | Drag-and-drop tool to define lead follow-up sequences | "Workflow builder" | "Automation rules" (too abstract) |
| **Generational UI** | Multiple interface themes designed for different age groups and software familiarity | "Your interface, your way" | "Skins" / "Themes" (sounds trivial) |
| **Instant Lead Verification** | Sub-5-second AI outbound call to verify and engage new leads | "Instant verification call" | "Speed-to-lead" (overused industry term) |
| **CarBot Coach** | AI role-play training platform for dealership staff | "Practice environment" / "Training platform" | "AI training bot" |
| **Live Stream** | Real-time call transcription and monitoring dashboard | "Live call intelligence" | "Call recording" (it's more than that) |
| **Micro-site** | Contextual customer-facing page generated per lead with vehicle and offer details | "Personal landing page" | "Email template" |
| **PII Redaction** | Automatic detection and removal of sensitive information from transcripts | "Smart privacy protection" | "Data scrubbing" |
| **10DLC** | 10-Digit Long Code — registered business texting numbers for compliance | "Registered business texting" | Don't explain the acronym to dealers |
| **STIR/SHAKEN** | Caller ID verification protocol to prevent spam flagging | "Verified caller ID" | Don't use the protocol name with dealers |

## 2) Capability Inventory

### 2.1 Centralized Conversation Hub
**What it does**: Aggregates every customer interaction — phone calls, texts, emails, AI conversations — into a single chronological conversation stack per customer.
**Outcome for GM**: Complete visibility without opening 4 systems.
**Outcome for GSM**: Know the full customer story before picking up the phone.
**Demo moment**: Open any customer record and scroll through the unified timeline.
[EVIDENCE: transcript MAP-Buying-Center 21:34-21:42]

### 2.2 Real-Time Call Streaming & Transcription
**What it does**: Pipes live audio from phone lines via websocket to transcription service. Calls appear on dashboard as they happen with word-by-word transcription.
**Outcome for GM**: See what's happening on your sales floor from anywhere.
**Outcome for GSM**: Coach in real time — catch problems before the call ends.
**Demo moment**: Make a call, watch it appear on screen within 1 second.
[EVIDENCE: transcript BDC-Pros-Extended 18:28-20:08]

### 2.3 Configurable AI Voice Agents (Personas)
**What it does**: Define named AI agents with specific personalities, prompting, voice selection, and behavioral rules. Assign them to workflow steps.
**Outcome for GM**: AI handles the 2am leads with a voice that represents your brand.
**Outcome for GSM**: Never miss a follow-up — AI handles the repetitive calls so your team handles the closeable ones.
**Demo moment**: Show the persona configuration screen, then trigger a live call from that persona.
[EVIDENCE: transcript MAP-Buying-Center 20:37-20:45]

### 2.4 Visual Workflow Editor
**What it does**: Drag-and-drop builder to define lead lifecycle sequences. Lead comes in → send text → wait 2 hours → AI call → if no answer → email → etc.
**Outcome for GM**: Your process runs itself. No more "did someone follow up on that?"
**Outcome for GSM**: Build the process once, it executes perfectly every time.
**Demo moment**: Walk through building a workflow in the visual editor.
[EVIDENCE: transcript MAP-Buying-Center 20:30-20:36]

### 2.5 AI Watcher (Auto-Task Management)
**What it does**: AI monitors completed calls and conversations, automatically schedules appointments, enrolls confirmations, creates follow-up tasks, and pushes completed actions back to the CRM. Runs nightly review of all open activities.
**Outcome for GM**: Tasks complete themselves. Appointments get confirmed without human effort.
**Outcome for GSM**: Your team works opportunities, not admin tasks.
**Demo moment**: Show a call ending with an appointment → appointment auto-appears in CRM.
[EVIDENCE: transcript MAP-Buying-Center 20:46-21:15]

### 2.6 Generational UI System (~20 Themes)
**What it does**: Same platform, same data, completely different interface depending on who's using it. Themes include Outlook, Apple Mail, Discord, Power BI, social feed, Gmail, TikTok, Salesforce, Apple Liquid Glass, and more.
**Outcome for GM/Older users**: Feels like the tools you already know.
**Outcome for younger users**: Feels like the apps you actually use.
**Demo moment**: Switch between 3-4 themes in succession showing the same customer data.
[EVIDENCE: transcript BDC-Pros-Extended 32:14-34:30]

### 2.7 Instant Lead Verification
**What it does**: Outbound AI call to customer within 5 seconds of lead submission. Verifies identity, confirms interest, can soft-set appointment or live-transfer to salesperson.
**Outcome for GM**: Every lead gets contacted before they contact your competitor.
**Outcome for GSM**: Your speed-to-lead is under 5 seconds, 24/7.
**Demo moment**: Submit a lead on demo website, watch phone ring within 5 seconds.
[EVIDENCE: transcript MAP-Buying-Center 14:36-15:34]

### 2.8 CarBot Coach (Role-Play Training)
**What it does**: AI-powered phone role-play where staff practice handling calls with AI customers. Customizable scenarios, personas, difficulty levels. Gamification with badges and streaks.
**Outcome for GM**: Train without risk. New hires get reps before they touch a real customer.
**Outcome for GSM**: Measurable skill building with 80% monthly active adoption rate.
**Demo moment**: Trigger a coaching call, role-play for 60 seconds.
[EVIDENCE: transcript BDC-Pros-Extended 03:16-04:19] [EVIDENCE: transcript MAP-Buying-Center 10:10-12:27]

### 2.9 Call Tracking & QA Scoring
**What it does**: Track all calls by department with AI-powered quality scoring, call grading, and analytics.
**Outcome for GM**: Know which departments need attention without listening to every call.
**Outcome for GSM**: Identify coaching opportunities with data, not gut feel.
[EVIDENCE: transcript BDC-Pros-Extended 17:55-18:06]

### 2.10 Smart PII Redaction
**What it does**: Post-call processing creates redacted transcripts and audio files. Distinguishes sensitive PII (credit cards, SSN) from non-sensitive context (employer address).
**Outcome for IT**: Transcript storage without compliance exposure.
**Outcome for GM**: Share call data freely without privacy concerns.
**Demo moment**: Show a transcript with credit card numbers redacted but contextual information preserved.
[EVIDENCE: transcript BDC-Pros-Extended 20:43-22:02]

### 2.11 Campaign Management
**What it does**: Toggle-on/off campaign layer for bulk outreach, follow-up sequences, and targeted communications.
**Outcome for GSM**: Run a service drive campaign without touching the CRM.
[EVIDENCE: transcript BDC-Pros-Extended 33:41-33:45]

### 2.12 Device Deployment (iOS / Apple TV)
**What it does**: Native deployment to iOS devices and Apple TV for showroom displays, sales floor TVs, or mobile usage.
**Outcome for GM**: Put a live dashboard on the showroom TV. Managers see activity from their phone.
[EVIDENCE: transcript BDC-Pros-Extended 34:57-35:07]

## 6) Known Limitations (Documented Honestly)

1. **VIN Solutions text logging**: Texts must be logged as notes, not native messages. VIN Solutions has not opened their messaging API despite 3 years of promises. This is a CRM-side constraint, not a CarBot limitation.
   [EVIDENCE: transcript BDC-Pros-Extended 28:30-28:39]

2. **Early deployment stage**: First autonomous dealer deployment was ~2 weeks before transcript date. Live production data for case studies is not yet available. Seed/demo data is what's currently shown.
   [EVIDENCE: transcript BDC-Pros-Extended 25:53-26:07]

3. **Open-source timeline not public**: The open-source release is planned but not yet publicly announced. Must be treated as [TIER C: INTERNAL ONLY] until formal announcement.
   [EVIDENCE: transcript MAP-Buying-Center 19:22-19:26]

4. **Dev environment rough edges**: Demo environments have been "torn apart" during development. Live demos may hit minor issues (as seen in BDC Pros call where lead verification triggered out of sequence).
   [EVIDENCE: transcript BDC-Pros-Extended 13:31-13:41]
